request: Analyze GSE198922 for PMID 38151020 (Exercise-induced crosstalk between immune cells and adipocytes in humans: Role of oncostatin-M.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded total RNA, NextSeq500), leg subcutaneous adipose tissue
final.primary_estimand: Within-subject change in adipose-tissue gene expression after one acute 30-min cycling bout (85% HRmax), at 0 min post-exercise (POST) and 3 h recovery (REC) versus pre-exercise basal (PRE), separately in NGT (n=20) and T2D (n=28) participants
final.sample_inclusion: 20 NGT (11M/9F) + 28 T2D (16M/12F) participants, three biopsies each (S2.1.p1, TAB1)
planned_contrasts: NGT POST vs PRE (S2.1.p1; paper: 712 DEGs)
T2D POST vs PRE (S2.1.p1; paper: 893 DEGs)
NGT REC vs PRE (S2.1.p1; count not stated exactly; T2D REC has 3228 genes not shared with NGT REC, implying 1088 shared)
T2D REC vs PRE (S2.1.p1; paper: 4316 DEGs)
T2D vs NGT at PRE (S2.1.p1; 589 DEGs; basal disease comparison, not an exercise contrast)
final.paper_method: edgeR filterByExpr (min.count 15, design ~0+group+sex); limma with quality weights (voomWithQualityWeights implied) on ~0 + group + sex, duplicateCorrelation blocking on participant (S4.4.2.p1)
final.paper_results: OSM among most induced post-exercise in both groups; CYR61(CCN1), CXCL2, HBEGF, IL6, COX2(PTGS2) highly induced post; SFRP4 and MXRA5 up at REC in T2D; PPARG down at REC in T2D only; LEP/ADIPOQ/RARRES2 decreased at REC

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S4.4.2.p1 gives filter, model (~0 + group + sex, quality weights, duplicateCorrelation on participant) and threshold (FDR 0.05, 'fold change cut-off of 0.1'); S2.1.p1 gives the per-group counts. 'Fold change cut-off of 0.1' is read as |logFC| > 0.1 on the limma log2 scale (a linear fold change of 0.1 is meaningless as a symmetric cutoff).
